A standard partner line connects Aa square and unknown circle; a single descent line starts at its midpoint and meets an unknown-sex diamond child. No arrowheads or genotype certainty are added.
All family symbols are unshaded as affected; the unknown parent and child remain question marks.
Population, Familie, 1 von 20, Aa and Modellrisiko remain readable at 360/680; the twenty dots remain countable and the child connection visible.
limitations: The illustration relies on the supplied fictional recessive model and a suitable reference population; it does not validate population matching.
No individual child-risk number is supplied and no Hardy-Weinberg assumption is implied.
A reference frequency does not establish an individual partner genotype or diagnosis; no clinical recommendation or true family data.
